days.title: Breathe with intention
days.description: Find a quiet spot. Sit comfortably. Practice 5 minutes of focused belly breathing, inhaling through your nose and exhaling slowly through your mouth.
days.tip: Place one hand on your belly to feel its rise and fall

days.title: Sun Salutation A - Watch & Learn
days.description: Watch a beginner's video (e.g., Yoga with Adriene) demonstrating Sun Salutation A. Focus on understanding the sequence and breath cues.
days.tip: Don't try to perfectly mirror the movements; just observe the flow

days.title: First Downward-Facing Dog
days.description: Try the Downward-Facing Dog pose. Focus on creating a long spine and bending your knees as much as needed.
days.tip: Spread your fingers wide and press through your palms to protect your wrists

days.title: Mountain to Forward Fold
days.description: Practice transitioning smoothly from Mountain Pose (Tadasana) to Forward Fold (Uttanasana) 5-7 times, coordinating with your breath.
days.tip: Keep a slight bend in your knees in Forward Fold to protect your hamstrings and lower back

days.title: Warrior II introduction
days.description: Learn and practice Warrior II (Virabhadrasana II). Pay attention to foot placement and arm alignment. Hold for 3-5 breaths per side.
days.tip: Ensure your front knee is stacked directly over your ankle, not past it

days.title: Short flow combining poses
days.description: Attempt a short sequence: Mountain Pose -> Forward Fold -> Downward-Facing Dog -> Warrior II (both sides) -> Mountain Pose. Repeat twice.
days.tip: Move with your breath; don't hold your breath during transitions

days.title: Week 1 check-in
days.description: Reflect on your experience this week. Which poses felt good? What was challenging? Note any physical sensations or mental shifts.
days.tip: Journaling your experience can help track progress and identify areas for focus
